description: person_read for PJHQ-7RG, the FamilySearch person behind I1 in scenario tyler-fluvanna-census (issue #4578, ut_research_iv3). In the Tyler feedback bundles that person is a tester's placeholder: name 'stub stub', gender Unknown, one undated Death fact and no attached sources (the bundle's starting-tree.gedcomx.json). The session never called person_read, so this restates that tree state rather than copying a recorded response. It exists because the router reads what is already attached before any search (research/SKILL.md, 'Start from what is already attached'), and person_read is not a live tool, so without a fixture that read would abort the run.
